relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Suzetrigine specifically binds to the voltage sensing domain 2 (VSD2) region of Nav1.8, inducing an allosteric structural change that stabilizes the channel in a closed state.

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: This prevents the propagation of new action potentials, thereby reducing pain signaling (Fig. 2).

relationships.subject: suzetrigine
relationships.evidence_quote: Treatment with suzetrigine showed significantly better pain relief compared to placebo, with a LS mean difference of 29.3 (95% CI: 14.0, 44.6), p=0.0002, indicating a significant reduction in pain.

relationships.subject: LTG-001
relationships.evidence_quote: Similar to suzetrigine, LTG-001 is a small molecule that selectively inhibits the Nav1.8 subtype of voltage-gated sodium channels (Gilchrist et al., 2024).

key_findings: Suzetrigine, a selective Nav1.8 inhibitor binding VSD2, is FDA-approved (Jan 2025) for moderate to severe acute pain.
Phase 3 trials: superior to placebo after abdominoplasty and bunionectomy; not significantly different from hydrocodone/APAP in abdominoplasty and inferior in bunionectomy.
